title: Sekundärfarben neu
slide_intent: Make shade families inspectable so designers can select a defined value rather than improvise a new color.
strategic_value: Named shade families can support consistent DB production and information graphics.
demonstration: Four adjacent cards display Cold Black, DB Red, Lilac and S-Bahn Green values with rows of shade swatches.
practical_value: Use the card’s named family and level when matching a shade to a role defined elsewhere.

content_islands.name: Shade-family cards
content_islands.spec: Align the four base cards with their color-system values and shade rows beneath each.

reference_purposes.Expression: The four color-family specimens display the palette’s tonal range.
reference_purposes.Application: Each card supplies named color values and selectable shade levels.
